name: Washington
overview: Washington does not sell tax liens. Once property taxes have been delinquent for three years, the county treasurer may start foreclosure by issuing certificates of delinquency, and the property is then sold by the treasurer at a public auction, which may be held online. The minimum bid is the total of the taxes, interest and costs. The owner can redeem up to the close of business the day before the sale; after the sale the treasurer issues a tax deed, with a three-year redemption right only for minors or legally incompetent owners.

overview_sources.quote: after the expiration of three years from the date of delinquency
the county treasurer may conduct a public auction sale by electronic media
The acceptable minimum bid must be the total amount of taxes, interest, and costs.
may be redeemed at any time before the close of business the day before the day of the sale
The county treasurer must execute to the purchaser of any piece or parcel of land a tax deed.
the same may be redeemed at any time within three years after the date of sale
